final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS g FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(g) AS tot FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.team_id AS team_id, s1.g AS g, CAST(s1.g AS REAL) / s2.tot AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(g) AS avg_g FROM s3) SELECT s3.team_id, s3.g, s3.share, CAST(s3.g AS REAL) / s4.avg_g AS ratio FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_g IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
